title: Educational Psychology Course October 2nd-December 12th, 2018
markdown:
***ATTENTION TEACHERS, PARENTS OR CHILD CAREGIVERS !!!!!!!***
October 1st through December 12th. Spaces limited.

**Educational Psychology**
This course is open to parents, teachers and prospective teachers with a good command of English. Thirty-two hours, 8 weeks, 4 hours weekly on Monday and Wednesdays. Evenings 7-9 PM. Examination with the grade requirement of 70 percent to receive a certificate.
The objective is to provide the student with insights into those psychological principles upon which effective classroom practice can be based. Parents,teachers and prospective teachers will be learning about the basic facts, principles, theories and viewpoints having an impact on the successful operation of the classroom and the educational development of children.
![](http://www.americangroup-international.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/recent-profile-768x1024.jpg)
**Lecturer:**
**Dr. Abdekghani Bouchouar Ph.D.,**
University of Wisconsin-Madison
Educational Sciences and Sociology
Ex Professor of Education Ecile Normale Supérieure Rabat and King Saud University, Saudi Arabia
Educational Consultant , Washington DC, USA.
Professor of English and Social Sciences, Agadir , Morocco.

This course is open to parents, teachers and prospective teachers with a good command of English.
The objective is to provide the student with insights into those psychological principles upon which effective classroom practice can be based. Parents,teachers and prospective teachers will be learning about the basic facts, principles, theories and viewpoints having an impact on the successful operation of the classroom and the educational development of children.
The following topics will be covered:
1. Introduction to educational sciences.
2. The changing teaching profession.
3. The learning process: major theories of learning.
4. Human development.
5. Children diversity.
6. Motivation.
7. Classroom management.
8. Assessment strategies for learning achievement.
9. Review and evaluation of the material.
